Available in Westwood

Your recovery essentials.

All four services are available in the Recovery Room. Choose PEX open access or a private reservation.

Westwood

Infrared sauna

Gentle infrared warmth for a slower moment in your day.

Benefits & considerations

Warmth, less tension & a slower mind. Clearlight infrared warmth offers a place to leave the day behind. People choose sauna time to unwind, soften the feeling of everyday tension, and settle into a calmer evening.

Make it your moment. A quiet break after work, some time to yourself, or part of a regular wind-down ritual. Let the warmth set a slower pace.

Westwood

Cold plunge

A cool-water immersion experience, on its own or alongside warmth.

Benefits & considerations

A mental reset & a refreshed outlook. Cold plunging is often chosen for the invigorating, clear-headed feeling afterward. The Coldtub experience invites you to be present, step out of mental autopilot, and enjoy a fresh sense of alertness.

Make it your moment. Whether your day has been busy, stressful, or simply ordinary, a comfortable cold-water pause can feel like a change of channel. Keep it brief and follow the studio guidance.

Westwood

Normatec compression

Rhythmic air compression around your legs while you recline.

Benefits & considerations

Lighter-feeling legs & everyday comfort. Normatec’s rhythmic air compression encourages circulation and offers a soothing squeeze-and-release massage. People reach for it after hours at a desk, a long drive, travel, or a day on their feet.

Make it your moment. Recline and let your legs have a break. In Framingham, add guided meditation for a little mental downtime, too.

Westwood

Red light therapy

Red and near-infrared light in the Westwood Recovery Room.

Benefits & considerations

Skin-focused care & everyday comfort. Our Westwood PlatinumLED BIOMAX PRO ULTRA panels bring red and near-infrared light into your self-care time. People explore this type of light therapy for skin appearance and everyday muscle and joint comfort, as well as a quiet moment to recharge.

Make it your moment. A little time for your skin, your body, and yourself. Enjoy a light-focused pause alongside your choice of sauna, cold plunge, or compression, following the studio’s guidance for the panels.

Choose what feels right for you. Experiences and results vary. If you are pregnant, have a heart or circulation condition, an implanted electronic device, or sensitivity to heat, cold, or flashing light, check with your healthcare professional before visiting and let us know. Our team can review the relevant studio guidance with you. Medical disclaimer (PDF) ↗
